events.title: Fortum Oyj (FOJCF) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Strong Market Prices and Strategic Growth Plans
events.body: Fortum Oyj (FOJCF) reports increased power prices and operating profit, while navigating challenges in nuclear generation and cash flow.

events.title: Fortum Oyj (FOJCF) Full Year 2025 Earnings Call Highlights: Navigating Challenges and Opportunities
events.body: Fortum Oyj (FOJCF) reports a mixed year with strong optimization premiums and cost reductions, despite lower generation volumes and cash flow.
